title: The return map of the cut-open torus as a one-dimensional operator, and its digit recursion
claim: For the cut-open torus walk at n = 2^m, h = n/2, over GF(2), with A_h = F[K]/(K^h) and its ball basis W_k (W_k(t + 1/t) = sum over |j| <= k of t^j): (1) the return map of CONE-COLLAPSE-20261109-001A is C_s(w) = w^(n+1) T_h(w^-2), T_h(c) the matrix of f -> (K + c)(iota f)(K + c) mod K^h, iota(W_k) = W_(h-1-k); (2) iota is multiplication by eps = W_(h-1) = 1 + sum over 1 <= j < m of K^(h - h/2^j), with eps^2 = 1 and eps_2h = 1 + K^h eps_h; (3) S_h(c) = T_h(c) R has the h distinct eigenvalues c/(zeta + 1/zeta), zeta an (n + 1)-th root of unity other than 1, with eigenvectors (K + c)/(K^2 + cK + z^2): c times the trace-1 elements of GF(n), det(zI + S_h) = c^h (1 + L_m(z/c)); (4) in the basis W_i, K^h W_i of A_2h, S_2h = [[S_h, c^h S_h], [E, S_h + c^h E]] and eps_2h = [[I, 0], [eps_h, I]] (E = top coefficient times 1), from T_1 = [c], and det(zI + T_2h) = det(z^2 + S_h^2 + c^h z (eps_h S_h + E)); (5) det(I - mu A_cone) = mu^(-h) det(sum over i = 0..m of mu^(2^i) C_i) with C_0 = S^-1, C_i = N^(h - 2^(i-1)), C_m = I on F[k]/(k^h) (N multiplication by k, S g = (k + 1) g(k + 1) mod k^h), so the collapse holds exactly when every nonzero root of that linearized determinant lies in GF(2n), equivalently when det(zI + T_h(c)) = 0 and z^2 = c^(n+1) force z^4 = c^3. Computed exactly: 1 + Tr_(GF(2n))(mu) divides det(I - mu A_cone) exactly once with a square quotient at sides 4 to 32. The target registered with this ticket, the collapse at every power of two, is not proved.
failure_conditions: A power of two at which C_s differs from w^(n+1) T_h(w^-2).
An h at which T_2h differs from P [[A(R + c^h), c^h AR], [A + u (c^h u + v)^T, AR + c^h u v^T]] P.
An h at which det(zI + T_h R) differs from c^h (1 + sum over j < m of (z/c)^(2^j)).
A power of two with a nonzero root of det(lambda^(n+1) I + T_h(lambda^2)) that is not a (2n - 1)-th root of unity (computed false at sides 4 to 128 by CONE-COLLAPSE-20261109-001).
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38); its walk over GF(2), at sides 2^m. The spectrum is a contact-level reading, so it does not depend on how the rings are declared (A45).
